eyebrow: What needs a workspace before it can run
code:
Sorts, hash joins, hash aggregates
  need a memory grant reserved
  BEFORE the query executes

Grant size = optimizer's estimated
  row count x row width

An ESTIMATE, not a measurement.
caption: The seed of most memory-grant problems.

code:
SELECT session_id, request_time, grant_time,
    requested_memory_kb, granted_memory_kb,
    used_memory_kb, max_used_memory_kb
FROM sys.dm_exec_query_memory_grants
ORDER BY requested_memory_kb DESC;
caption: NULL grant_time = still waiting. That's RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE, visible.

code:
Grant pool: finite, shared, bounded
  (a % of buffer pool budget,
   not all of physical RAM)

RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE can appear even
with plenty of RAM if too many
over-sized grants request at once.

Usual cause: bad cardinality
estimate, not too little memory.
caption: Fix the estimate — stats, parameter sniffing, rewrites.
